# smallstep_ethernet (Resource)

Configuration for connecting a device to an EAP-TLS 802.1X wired network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "smallstep_ethernet" "my_wired_net" {
  name             = "CorpNet"
  radius_server_ca = smallstep_managed_radius.my_radius.server_ca
  autojoin         = true
  credentials      = [smallstep_credential.device.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `radius_server_ca` (String) The certificate bundle used to verify the RADIUS server.

### Optional

- `autojoin` (Boolean) Whether or not clients should automatically connect to the network.
- `credentials` (Set of String) The UUID of credentials that the Smallstep agent will configure to use this ethernet integration.
- `name` (String) A human-friendly display name for this resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of this protected Ethernet configuration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import smallstep_ethernet.my_wired_net 5b7d3dd5-bd1b-4a17-842f-e3c620ce4b85
```
